parent.name: The Pool (Devotion’s perpendicularity)
parent.desc: A small, deep pool of thick, crystalline blue liquid in the Atad Mountains south-east of Elantris, reached by tunnel or switchbacks. It opens into Sel’s Cognitive Realm.
facts: AonDor, Forgery, Dakhor and more, tied to the land
Arelon, Teod, the Fjordell Empire, the Rose Empire
parent.card:
Expanse of the Densities

Sel’s subastral is all but uninhabitable. The power of the splintered Shards Devotion and Dominion was forced into the Cognitive Realm, where it forms the Dor: a pressurised, plasma-like storm. A few guides can lead travellers through it.
parent.codex:
Adonalsium

The single power behind creation, shattered long before the books into sixteen Shards. It was destroyed on Yolen by a group that included Hoid.

Honor

Shard of oaths and bonds on Roshar, said to be dead; his voice survives in Dalinar’s visions. Merged with Odium after Dalinar renounced it, forming Retribution.

Cultivation

Shard of growth and change on Roshar, the Nightwatcher’s power, rarely seen directly.

Odium

Shard of passion and division, the enemy behind the Desolations, who has killed other Shards. He splintered Devotion and Dominion on Sel and wounded Ambition at Threnody. His vessel Rayse is killed and Taravangian takes the Shard. Becomes Retribution.

Preservation

Shard of stability on Scadrial, who made the mists.

Ruin

Shard of entropy, trapped at the Well of Ascension and working through lies.

Harmony

Sazed holding both Preservation and Ruin, god of Scadrial’s second era.

Devotion and Dominion

The Shards of Sel. Their broken power lingers in the land and drives Sel’s many magics.

Endowment

Shard of Nalthis, giver of Breath and of the Returned.

Autonomy

Shard of Taldain, who likes many avatars and dislikes rivals. Claims the world of Obrodai and raises an avatar there. Reaches toward Scadrial in The Lost Metal. Patji, the deadly island of First of the Sun, is one of its avatars.

Ambition

A Shard mortally wounded in a battle with Odium in the empty space of the Threnodite system. The battle still twists the Investiture on Threnody.

Virtuosity

A Shard who splintered herself near Komashi.

Valor

A Shard who was active on Miral and founded temples there.

Retribution

Odium and Honor merged under Taravangian, now one of the greatest threats in the cosmere.

selEvents.title: Raoden is taken
selEvents.text: The prince of Arelon wakes with the Shaod and is quietly thrown into Elantris, declared dead to the world.

selEvents.title: A widow before the wedding
selEvents.text: Sarene reaches Kae and learns that Raoden is reported dead; their contract makes her his widow.

selEvents.title: Hrathen’s three months
selEvents.text: A priest of Fjorden comes with a deadline: convert Arelon, or watch it destroyed.

selEvents.title: The land is part of the writing
selEvents.text: Raoden discovers that adding a line for the Chasm lets his Aons function again.

selEvents.title: Elantris shines again
selEvents.text: Raoden adds the missing Chasm line to the city-scale Aon, restoring Elantris.

selEvents.title: The Emperor’s Soul
selEvents.text: A condemned Forger, Shai, has ninety-eight days to recreate Emperor Ashravan’s soul; his body has been healed, but his mind remains blank.
